Egyptian Numerals, Q1
questions.q_figure: The table of Egyptian symbols: a stroke for 1, a heel for 10, a coil for 100, a lotus for 1000 and a finger for 10000.
questions.s_figure: Each of the six numbers drawn as an Egyptian numeral with the finger, lotus, coil, heel and stroke symbols.

questions.q_figure: Two Egyptian numerals drawn with their symbols: (i) two coils, seven heels and six strokes; (ii) four lotuses, three coils, two heels and two strokes.

questions.name: Base-n Systems, Q1
questions.q_figure: Table 2 of the base-5 symbols: a triangle for 1, a square for 5, a hexagon for 25, a circle for 125, a wave for 625 and an arrow for 3125, each shown with its power of 5.
questions.s_figure: Each of the five numbers drawn as a base-5 numeral with the triangle, square, hexagon, circle and wave symbols.

questions.name: Adding With Landmarks: add 87 and 78 in Egyptian numerals
questions.q_figure: Two Egyptian numerals one above the other with a plus sign between them: 8 heels and 7 strokes, and 7 heels and 8 strokes.
questions.s_figure: The same sum regrouped: 15 strokes become 1 heel and 5 strokes, 16 heels become 1 coil and 6 heels, giving 1 coil, 6 heels and 5 strokes.

questions.name: Adding With Landmarks, Q1
questions.q_figure: Two sums of Egyptian numerals drawn with their symbols: (i) 9 lotuses, 6 coils and 8 strokes plus 5 coils and 7 strokes; (ii) 1 lotus and 8 heels plus 4 heels and 6 strokes.
questions.s_figure: Each sum regrouped and drawn as one Egyptian numeral: (i) 1 finger, 1 coil, 1 heel and 5 strokes; (ii) 1 lotus, 1 coil, 2 heels and 6 strokes.

questions.q_figure: Two base-5 numerals drawn with a plus sign between them: 1 circle, 2 hexagons, 1 square and 2 triangles, and 3 circles, 1 hexagon, 2 squares and 2 triangles.
questions.s_figure: The sum drawn as one base-5 numeral: 4 circles, 3 hexagons, 3 squares and 4 triangles.

questions.name: The Counting Board: add 2907 and 43
questions.q_figure: A counting board with horizontal lines for 1, 10, 100 and 1000 and a vertical partition down the middle: 2907 in counters on the left and 43 on the right, a counter above a line standing for 5 of that line.
questions.s_figure: The board after the counters are brought together: 2 counters on the 1000 line, 1 above and 4 on the 100 line, 1 above the 10 line and none on the 1 line.

questions.name: Mayan Numerals: write 77, 100, 361 and 721
questions.q_figure: The Mayan symbols: a dot for 1, a bar for 5 and a shell for 0, with the places for 1s, 20s and 360s stacked one above the other.
questions.s_figure: Each of the four numbers drawn as a Mayan numeral with dots, bars and a shell, one place above the next.

questions.name: Place Value, Q1
questions.q_figure: The Chinese rod numerals for 1 to 9 drawn in both the vertical zong form and the horizontal heng form.
questions.s_figure: The numeral for 41 drawn with zong rods only: four vertical rods then one vertical rod, with no gap between them.
